item.title: Version 1.50.12 (144)
item.description:
RAW export for Zerene Stacker

  • Full-resolution 8-bit or 16-bit uncompressed RGB TIFF conversion.
  • Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, and sRGB with verified ICC profiles.
  • Batch selection and recursive folder conversion with one locked RAW recipe.
  • White balance, exposure, tone, noise reduction, sharpening, lens correction, and highlight recovery controls.
  • Disk preflight, atomic output, stop/retry, manifests, destination choices, and optional Zerene handoff.
  • RAW originals and existing TIFFs are never overwritten.
